luckysurvival.description: Classic survival with fair PvP, balanced economy and an active community.
luckysurvival.detailDescription: LuckySurvival offers classic Minecraft survival with fair PvP, a balanced in-game economy, and an active community.
luckysurvival.detailDescriptionDesktop: LuckySurvival offers a classic Minecraft survival experience with fair PvP, a balanced in-game economy, and an active community — built for both casual and competitive players.
luckysurvival.aboutText: LuckySurvival is vanilla survival with PvP enabled and TNT disabled. Fair fights, balanced economy, and long-term progression for chill and competitive players alike.
luckysurvival.aboutTextDesktop: LuckySurvival is vanilla survival with PvP enabled and TNT disabled. Fair fights, a hand-tuned economy, and long-term progression — ideal for players who enjoy active gameplay, fair competition, and economic strategy.
luckysurvival.featureD0: Classic open-world survival with day/night cycle
luckysurvival.featureD1: Fair combat arenas and open-world PvP zones
luckysurvival.featureD2: Buy, sell and trade items with other players

minewars.description: High-intensity PvP combat, ranked matches, team battles and seasonal tournaments.
minewars.detailDescription: MineWars is built for competitive players — ranked matches, seasonal tournaments, and team warfare with PvP and TNT enabled.
minewars.detailDescriptionDesktop: MineWars is built for competitive players who thrive in combat. Join ranked ladder matches, compete in seasonal tournaments, and rise through team-based warfare with vanilla PvP and TNT enabled.
minewars.aboutText: MineWars is vanilla survival with PvP and TNT enabled. Ranked matches, tournaments, and team warfare — every battle counts.
minewars.aboutTextDesktop: MineWars is vanilla survival with PvP and TNT enabled. Join ranked ladder matches, compete in seasonal tournaments, and claim territory through team-based warfare and conquest.
minewars.featureD0: Intense player vs player battles in dedicated arenas
minewars.featureD1: Weekly and seasonal competitive tournaments with prizes
minewars.featureD2: Climb the competitive ladder and earn exclusive rewards
minewars.featureD3: Faction-based team combat and territory control

calmsky.description: A relaxed, peaceful server for building, exploring and enjoying Minecraft at your own pace.
calmsky.detailDescription: CalmSky is a peaceful haven — no PvP, no TNT. Focus on building, exploring, and community.
calmsky.detailDescriptionDesktop: CalmSky is a peaceful haven for players who want to focus on building, exploring, and community without the stress of combat. No PvP, no TNT — just creativity and collaboration.
calmsky.aboutText: CalmSky is vanilla survival without PvP or TNT. Claim your plot, join build contests, and share creations with a supportive community.
calmsky.aboutTextDesktop: CalmSky is vanilla survival without PvP or TNT. Claim your plot, explore vast landscapes, join friendly build contests, and share your creations with a supportive community.
calmsky.featureD0: Unlimited creative mode with premium WorldEdit tools
calmsky.featureD1: Vast unexplored worlds with custom biomes and structures
calmsky.featureD2: Regular community build competitions with prizes
calmsky.featureD3: Claim your own plot and build with neighbors
